query: 'SELECT
    YEAR(c.fecha) * 10000 + MONTH(c.fecha) * 100 + DAY(c.fecha) AS fecha_key,
    CAST(c.fecha AS DATE) AS fecha_completa,
    CAST(YEAR(c.fecha) AS INT) AS anio,
    CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, c.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS trimestre,
    CONCAT('T', DATEPART(QUARTER, c.fecha)) AS trimestre_nombre,
    CAST(MONTH(c.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS mes,

    CASE MONTH(c.fecha)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Enero'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Febrero'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Marzo'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Abril'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Mayo'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Junio'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Julio'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'Agosto'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Septiembre'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Octubre'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Noviembre'
        WHEN 12 THEN 'Diciembre'
    END AS mes_nombre,

    CASE MONTH(c.fecha)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Ene'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Feb'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Mar'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Abr'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Jun'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Jul'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'Ago'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Sep'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Oct'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Nov'
        WHEN 12 THEN 'Dic'
    END AS mes_corto,

    CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, c.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS semana_anio,
    CAST(DAY(c.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS dia_mes,

    CAST((DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', c.fecha) % 7) + 1 AS TINYINT) AS dia_semana,

    CASE (DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', c.fecha) % 7) + 1
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Lunes'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Martes'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Miércoles'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Jueves'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Viernes'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Sábado'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Domingo'
    END AS dia_nombre,

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN (DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', c.fecha) % 7) + 1 IN (6, 7)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END AS BIT
    ) AS es_fin_de_semana

FROM (
    SELECT DATEADD(DAY, n.n, l.fecha_min) AS fecha
    FROM (
        SELECT
            MIN(fecha) AS fecha_min,
            MAX(fecha) AS fecha_max
        FROM (
            SELECT admission_date AS fecha FROM silver.admissions
            UNION ALL
            SELECT discharge_date FROM silver.admissions
            UNION ALL
            SELECT payment_date FROM silver.billing
        ) f
    ) l
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT TOP (100000)
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS n
        FROM sys.all_objects a
        CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b
    ) n
    WHERE n.n <= DATEDIFF(DAY, l.fecha_min, l.fecha_max)
) c',
